scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n node,backend,frontend -c yellow,blue,green "npm --prefix contracts run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix contracts test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
